summary: Completed comprehensive testing of DataLens MVP. Backend APIs fully functional (7/7 tests passed). Frontend pages load correctly with proper authentication protection. File upload interface present but session persistence needs investigation.

integration_issues.issue: Session cookies may not persist properly in browser, causing authenticated dashboard to redirect to landing page

passed_tests: Backend API /api/plans returns all 3 pricing plans (free, pro, team)
Authentication endpoints work with test sessions
File upload API accepts CSV and generates analysis
Analysis generates complete profile data (overview, variables, correlations, alerts)
Landing page loads with 'Continue with Google' button
Pricing page displays 3 plan cards with correct pricing ($0, $12, $29)
File upload interface present in authenticated dashboard
All supported file formats displayed (CSV, XLSX, JSON, Parquet)
Feature cards display correctly (4 features shown)
action_item_for_main_agent: Investigate frontend authentication session persistence. The dashboard authentication protection works (redirects unauthenticated users), but authenticated sessions may not persist properly in browser cookies. This could be related to cookie SameSite settings, domain configuration, or session token handling in the frontend AuthContext.
